name: terminal
description: Shell commands with foreground/background process lifecycle. Filesystem authority, account HOME, workspaces and confinement are resolved live from the Sandbox control; a missing owner fails closed except for an explicit instance-operator host fallback.

configSchema.label: Limits
configSchema.hint: Output size and timeout caps for shell commands.

configSchema.label: Output cap
configSchema.hint: How many bytes of stdout/stderr are returned before truncation. Also caps the rolling output buffer kept for background processes.

configSchema.label: Command timeout (ms)
configSchema.hint: How long a foreground command may run before it is killed.

configSchema.label: Background processes per session
configSchema.hint: How many background processes one session and account may keep running at once; starting another is refused until one is killed. Range 1-64, default 16.
